Model: V.Analog. Microfreak/UG/06 Dig Osc/03 Types/06 VAnalog
Low-pass filter. Saved cutoff: 0.088; resonance: 0.101. Microfreak/UG/07 Filter/01 Modifying Sound/01 Low Pass Filter
Main envelope: attack 0.209, decay/release 0.716, sustain 0.566. Amp Mod is on, so the main envelope controls loudness. Microfreak/UG/09 Envelope Gen/03 Envelope Stages
Cycling Envelope mode: Loop. Stored RiseLvl 0.024, RiseSlp 0.500, FallLvl 0.356, FallSlp 0.500, Hold 0.052, Amount 1.000. Microfreak/UG/09 Envelope Gen/06 Cycling Envelope
Sample-and-Hold Filtered, clock sync off; stored normalized rate: 0.148. Microfreak/UG/08 LFO/01 LFO Shape · Microfreak/UG/08 LFO/02 LFO Rate
Amounts use the signed normalized range −1…+1. Microfreak/UG/05 Connections/02 Matrix and Encoder/01 Sources and Destinations
All other saved matrix amounts are zero.

The main envelope opens the low-pass filter as it pulls V.Analog Wave down. Listen for the change in color as a held note swells and settles. The cycling envelope also moves Timbre during a held note.
The spoken introduction identifies Qbit Brass in GitP/A/Session/26/11/18-Wed. The October capture documents the factory settings. The recording combines separate audio takes with panning and reverb.
Values describe saved base settings before modulation. Controls use normalized 0…1 values unless a stored choice code is shown; they are not OLED percentages, hertz or milliseconds.
Microfreak/CLI/Inspect a preset preserves the original fields. Oscillator interpretation assumes the documented firmware 5 layout; firmware is not detected from the export.
Matrix assignments follow the Freakout live map. Mode, LFO shape, filter type and octave labels follow the MicroFreak Reader definitions.
